verdict.rationale: Per-institution health is a fair axis for a bank-data aggregator like Teller, but the evidence pack documents no institution status endpoint, no outage or degradation signals, and no error-code taxonomy separating bank-side from integration-side failures. Enrollment webhooks (teller-docs-17) cover changes to user enrollments, which is an adjacent feature rather than institution health, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an ops lead, per-institution health is visible — documented institution statuses, outage or degradation signals, and error codes that distinguish a bank problem from my problem
